tenderSchedule.title: Providing Man Power Services for Technicians and Other Staff to BMCRC Ballari
tenderSchedule.description: Providing Man Power Services for Technicians and Other Staff to BMCRC Ballari
tenderSchedule.locationName: Vijayanagar Institute of Medical Sciences Ballari

tenderAddress.blockNumber: In the chamber of Dean and Director, BMCRC

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All other terms and condition as per tender bid document

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: PERFORMANCE CONTRACT STATEMENT & EXPERIENCE CERTIFICATE With WORK ORDERS:-The Agency should have Experience of provided man power to maintenance of Technician and other staff Services at Government Hospitals/Quasi Government Hospitals/Government Autonomous Medical Institutions/ Any Government Institutions/Private Medical Colleges & Hospitals/Corporate Sectors and should have provided minimum 160 Labours per year for last 02 financial years of 2024-25 and 2025-26the details as per the Performance Contracts Statement as per the ANNEXURE-III along with EXPERIENCE CERTIFICATES as per ANNEXURE-IV or its equivalent or as per the Principal Employers Format that consisting of required information and its related WORK ORDERS should be uploaded in original/self attested.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- PERFORMANCE CONTRACT STATEMENT & EXPERIENCE CERTIFICATE With WORK ORDERS

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: PAN CARD:-The Agency or Tenderer should have PAN CARD and should be uploaded in original/self attested.

ESI REGISTRATION CERTIFICATE:- The Agency should have valid ESI registration certificate issued by the Office of the Regional Provident Fund Commissioner a s per ESI Act and should be uploaded in original

PROFESSIONAL TAX REGISTRATION FORM No.3 CERTIFICATE:- The Agency must have Certificate of Enrolment issued under Karnataka Tax on Professions, Traders, Calling and Employment Act1976 (Form-3) should be uploaded in original

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- PROFESSIONAL TAX REGISTRATION FORM No.3 CERTIFICATE

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: QUALITY CONTROL CERTIFICATE:- The Agency should have valid ISO9001:2015 Quality Control Certificate for Man Power Services and should be uploaded in original
SELF DECLARATION :-The Agency shall give Self Declaration in Rs.500/- Stamp Paper attested by the Government Notary as per the ANNEXURE-II.
SSI/MSME/NSIC Certificate should be uploaded in original/self attested
TENDER OFFER FORM :- The Tender Offer Form as per the ANNEXURE-VII should be uploaded in original
EMD:-The Tenderer should remit Earnest Money in the e-portal and Receipt is to be uploaded in original with seal & Signature
Office address:-The Tenderer should have the office at ballari city limit

GOVERNMENT OF KARNATAKA DEPARTMENT OF LABOUR REGISTRATION CERTIFICATE OF ESTABLISHMENT FORM-C and FORM-VI a)The Agency should have valid Registration Certificate of Establishment issued under Karnataka Shops and Commercial Establishment act of 1961, according to Government of Karnataka, Department of Labour Government of Karnataka. b)should have registered with minimum 160 Labours engaged should be uploaded in attested copy of Form C from labor department to be submitted as last two Financial Years.c)Form- VI Under Section 12(1) of the Contract Labour Act-1970 uploaded in attested Government of Karnataka Department of Labour department with minimum 160
GST REG 06 CERTIFICATE:-The Agency should have GST REG-06 registration certificate and should be uploaded in original /self attested.

GST RETURNS STATEMENT:- GSTR Returns Statement as per Annexure-IX for the last Two Financial years 2024-25 and 2025-26 certified by the Chartered Accountant with UDIN Number in original and last Six Months GST returns copies should be uploaded

EPF REGISTRATION CERTIFICATE:-The Agency should have valid EPF registration certificate issued by the Office of the Regional Provident Fund Commissioner as per EPF Act and should be uploaded in original.

EPF REMITTANCE STATEMENT WITH CLEARANCE CERTIFICATE:-The Agency should submit the EPF Remittance Statement Annexure-X minimum for Rs.43.00 Lakhs per Annum for having remitted for the Financial year 2024-25 and 2025-26 duly certified by the Office of the Regional Provident Fund Commissioner and Last 06 Months EPF Challans as per EPF Act should be uploaded in original

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- EPF REMITTANCE STATEMENT WITH CLEARANCE CERTIFICATE

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: ESI REMITTANCE STATEMENT WITH CLEARANCE CERTIFICATE:-The Agency should submit the ESI Remittance Statement Annexure-XI minimum for Rs.11.00 Lakhs per Annum for having remitted for the Financial year 2024-25 and 2025-26duly certified by the Office of Sub-Regional and Last 06 Months ESI Challans should be uploaded in original

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- ESI REMITTANCE STATEMENT WITH CLEARANCE CERTIFICATE

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: PROFESSIONAL TAX CLEARANCE CERTIFICATE:- The Agency should submit the Professional Tax clearance certificate as on 31/03/2025 issued by the Commissioner of Commercial Tax Department should be uploaded in original

ANNUAL TURNOVER CERTIFICATE:-The Agency should submit the Annual Turnover for the last Two financial years i.e. 2024-25 and 2025-26 for having minimum Rs.512.00 Lakhs turnover per any one year per ANNEXURE-VIII provided Man power to maintenance of Technician and other staff issued & certified by the Chartered Accountant along with UDIN Number should be uploaded in Original
ITR RETURNS:-Income Tax Returns ITR for the last Two Financial years with trading, P & L Balance Sheet 2024-25 and 2025-26 in original should be uploaded duly certified by the -Chartered Accountant
